name: Salah
overview: Salah, also known as Sala or Shelah, is presented in Scripture as a key patriarchal figure, being the son of Arphaxad and the father of Eber. His genealogy, recorded in Genesis 10:24, 11:12-15, and 1 Chronicles 1:18, establishes him as an important ancestor in the lineage leading to Joseph. The detailed accounts of his lifespan and descendants emphasize his role in God's providential unfolding of the covenantal line.
